'''Kemla Yard''' was a [[Shipyard/Legends|shipyard]] located at [[Kemla]]. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], this [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] shipyard refitted the [[Acclamator-class transgalactic military assault ship/Legends|Acclamator-class assault ship]] ''[[Leveler]]'' with experimental weapons.<ref name="NP">''[[The Clone Wars: No Prisoners]]''</ref> The Kemla shipyard was turned into [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] military shipyards after the [[Declaration of a New Order]] and dedicated to the production of [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyers]].<ref name="TEGtW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref>
